column2: With rising anticipation, the villagers gathered at dawn to watch the eclipse.
column3: 村民懷著越來越高的期待，在黎明聚集觀看日蝕。
column5: anticipate 的名詞：搶先在心裡等著好事發生

column2: At the apex of the pyramid, a single gold-tipped stone caught the first sunlight.
column3: 金字塔頂端有一塊鑲金的石頭，最先接住了陽光。
column4: the apex of power (權力頂點)
column5: a-pex 像「阿佩斯」爬到最頂端，插一面旗

column2: The laboratory's breathing apparatus had to be tested before every dive.
column3: 實驗室的呼吸裝置在每次潛水前都必須先測試。
column5: a-ppa-ra-tus：一整套準備好的器材，就是儀器設備
column8: 儀器；設備；機構組織運作

column2: Please append a short note to the report explaining the missing figures.
column3: 請在報告後面附上一則簡短說明，解釋缺漏的數字。
column5: ap 朝 + pend 掛：把東西掛在後面，附加上去

column2: The maps and charts were collected in an appendix at the back of the book.
column3: 地圖和圖表都收在書末的附錄中。
column4: appendix to the book (書的附錄)
column5: append 掛在後面：掛在書尾的就是附錄，身體裡掛在腸子旁的是闌尾

column2: An expert was hired to appraise the antique clock before it went up for auction.
column3: 古董鐘拍賣前，他們請專家來估價。
column5: 像 praise 稱讚，但先看這東西值多少錢才評價

column2: A professional appraisal put the old farmhouse at twice its purchase price.
column3: 專業估價顯示這棟老農舍值買價的兩倍。
column5: appraise 的名詞：估價師寫的那張鑑定書

column2: The approximate distance to the summit is about six kilometers.
column3: 到山頂的大約距離是六公里左右。
column5: ap 朝 + proxim 近：靠得很近但不完全一樣，就是近似

column2: Her quick approximation of the cost turned out to be within five dollars.
column3: 她快速估算出的費用，最後誤差在五美元以內。
column5: approximate 的名詞：靠近真實，但不是剛剛好

column2: The king's arbitrary ruling, made on a whim, angered the entire court.
column3: 國王憑一時興致做出的武斷裁決，激怒了整個朝廷。
column5: arbi 像「啊比」：啊，隨便比一比就決定了，沒有道理

column2: Cinderella is the archetype of the kind person who is rewarded after hardship.
column3: 灰姑娘是善良的人歷經苦難後獲得回報的典型。
column5: arche 最初 + type 類型：最原始的模板
column8: 原型；典型；範本；原始意象

column2: After an arduous climb through knee-deep snow, they finally reached the hut.
column3: 歷經在及膝積雪中艱苦的攀登，他們終於抵達山屋。
column5: 諧音「阿肚死」：爬到阿肚子累死，非常費力

column2: Archaeologists catalogued every artifact found in the ancient burial chamber.
column3: 考古學家為古代墓室中發現的每件文物編目。
column5: arti 技藝 + fact 做成：人做出來的東西
column8: 歷史；人工製品；文物；史料

column2: Investigators worked through the night to ascertain exactly how the fire began.
column3: 調查人員徹夜工作，要查明火災究竟如何開始。
column5: as 朝 + certain 確定：弄到確定為止，就是查明

column2: As a child in a fishing village, he aspired to become an astronaut.
column3: 他小時候住在漁村，立志成為太空人。
column4: aspire to greatness (渴望成就大事)
column5: a 朝 + spire 呼吸：朝著夢想用力吸氣、往上衝

column2: Her aspiration to teach had been growing since her first volunteer summer.
column3: 自從第一個志工暑假起，她想當老師的志向就一直增長。
column5: aspire 的名詞：呼吸著夢想往上衝的心願

column2: Plants assimilate nutrients from the soil and turn them into new leaves.
column3: 植物從土壤吸收養分，並把它們轉化成新葉子。
column5: as 朝 + simil 相似：吃進去變成和自己一樣
column8: 吸收；消化；同化；融入群體

column2: The cultural assimilation of immigrants often takes more than a single generation.
column3: 移民的文化同化往往需要不只一個世代。
column5: assimilate 的名詞：慢慢變得跟大家一樣的過程
column8: 文化同化；吸收；融合過程

column2: Historians attribute the empire's collapse to a combination of drought and heavy taxes.
column3: 歷史學家將帝國的崩潰歸因於乾旱與重稅雙重打擊。
column4: attribute success to (把成功歸因於)
column5: at 朝 + tribute 給予：把功勞或過錯給到某個原因

column2: The attribution of the painting to a famous master was later proved false.
column3: 這幅畫被歸為名家之作，後來證明是錯的。
column4: attribution of cause (歸因於某原因)
column5: attribute 的名詞：把作品或原因歸給某人

column2: The tiny pill is an augmentation of the standard dose, not a replacement.
column3: 這顆小藥丸是標準劑量的加強，不是替代品。
column5: aug 是「增加」，像拿放大鏡把東西越變越大

column2: The restaurant serves authentic Thai noodles made from a grandmother's recipe.
column3: 這家餐廳供應用阿嬤食譜做的道地泰式麵。
column5: au-then-tic：「喔，真的啦」，確實是真貨
column8: 真實；道地；真確；非仿造的

column2: Experts used a special lamp to authenticate the signature on the old letter.
column3: 專家用特殊燈光鑑定這封舊信上的簽名真偽。
column5: authentic 真的 + ate 動詞：把它驗成是真的

column2: Scholars questioned the authenticity of the diary after finding modern ink in its pages.
column3: 學者在日記頁面發現現代墨水後，質疑它的真實性。
column5: authentic 真的 + ity：是不是真貨的程度

column2: Autonomous vehicles use cameras and sensors to steer themselves through traffic.
column3: 自動駕駛車輛利用鏡頭和感測器，自己在車流中行駛。
column5: auto 自己 + nom 規則：自己訂規則自己管

column2: Teenagers crave more autonomy as they begin making their own decisions.
column3: 青少年開始自己做決定時，會渴望更多自主權。
column5: auto 自己 + nom 規則：自己的事自己決定

column2: A quick turn of the wheel was enough to avert a collision with the truck.
column3: 方向盤快速一轉，就足以避免與卡車相撞。
column5: a 離開 + vert 轉：轉個方向躲開

column2: The riddle was so tricky that it baffled even the oldest villagers.
column3: 這個謎語太刁鑽，連最年長的村民也被難倒。
column5: 諧音「爸佛」：爸爸看了也佛了，一頭霧水
column8: 使困惑；難倒；使不知所措

column2: A language barrier made it hard for the new students to join the conversation.
column3: 語言隔閡讓新來的學生難以加入對話。
column5: bar 是柵欄，加上 -ier 像一堵擋路的牆

column2: Small cafes began to burgeon along the riverbank once the new bridge opened.
column3: 新橋啟用後，小咖啡館開始在河岸邊迅速冒出。
column5: 諧音「不真」：一夜萌芽，快得不真實

column2: Technicians must calibrate the scale each morning to keep the weights accurate.
column3: 技術人員每天早上都必須校準磅秤，讓重量保持準確。
column5: cali 像 caliber 口徑：量準尺寸，把儀器調整到對

column2: Regular calibration keeps the thermometer from drifting away from the true temperature.
column3: 定期校準能避免溫度計漸漸偏離真實溫度。
column5: calibrate 的名詞：每次校準，讀數才會準

column2: With refreshing candor, the coach admitted that the team had played poorly.
column3: 教練坦率承認球隊表現不佳，令人耳目一新。
column5: 諧音「看到」：看到什麼就說什麼，坦率

column2: The invention of the printing press was a catalyst for the spread of knowledge.
column3: 印刷術的發明促成了知識的傳播。
column4: catalyst for change (改變的催化劑)
column5: 像小火苗，一點就讓整個反應快速進行，促成改變
column8: 催化劑；促成改變的誘因

column2: The earthquake was a catastrophe that destroyed most of the harbor town.
column3: 那場地震是一場大災難，摧毀了港口小鎮的大半。
column5: cata 往下 + strophe 轉：事情急轉直下，一敗塗地

column2: The storm caused catastrophic flooding that swept away roads and bridges.
column3: 風暴造成毀滅性的洪水，沖走了道路與橋梁。
column5: catastrophe 大災難 + ic：像大災難一樣嚴重的

column2: The committee voted to censure the senator for misusing campaign funds.
column3: 委員會投票通過公開譴責那位參議員濫用競選經費。
column5: 大家都覺得你做錯了，當眾嚴厲指責你

column2: A careful chronology of the war helped students see how each battle led to the next.
column3: 詳細的戰爭年表幫助學生看出每場戰役如何連到下一場。
column5: chrono 時間 + logy 學問：把事情照時間排好的學問

column2: The museum arranged the tools in chronological order, from the oldest to the newest.
column3: 博物館把工具依時間順序排列，從最古老的到最新的。
column5: chrono 時間：像時鐘一樣照時間先後排好

column2: Strict rules circumscribe what the apprentices are allowed to do in the workshop.
column3: 嚴格規定限制了學徒在工坊裡可以做的事。
column5: circum 圍繞 + scribe 寫：用筆畫一圈，圈住範圍
column8: 限制；劃定界限；限制活動
